about.title: About the Project
about.description: This project is a sample .Net 8.0 web API with React and Docker support project for demonstration purposes and as a starting point for a fullstack application. It demonstrates the use of .Net 8.0 SDK, React, Docker, and Nginx for creating a development and production environment for web applications.

aiConsole.title: AI Console
aiConsole.subtitle: Choose the model and tuning used by every generative-AI feature in CodeJitsu. Changes are saved as overrides on top of the server defaults and take effect for the next request. Use Test model to send a tiny prompt with the unsaved values before saving.

noAccess.body: This area is limited to administrators. If you think you should have access, contact the project owner.

video-analysis-pipeline.title: Video analysis — agentic pipeline
video-analysis-pipeline.description: 4-phase Vertex AI analysis of uploaded sparring videos (Profiler → Event Logger → Verifier → Head Coach). All phases share one model.

video-analysis-single-shot.title: Video analysis — single-shot (legacy v1)
video-analysis-single-shot.description: Original one-request analysis of a sparring video. Kept for older recordings and as a fallback.

class-curriculum.title: Class curriculum generator
class-curriculum.description: Builds a structured class plan (warm-up, techniques, drills, sparring) for a training session.

fighter-pairing.title: Fighter pairing
fighter-pairing.description: Suggests sparring pairs for a class based on belt, weight, experience and goals.

technique-search.title: Technique resource search
technique-search.description: Finds instructional videos and articles with Google Search grounding, then verifies every YouTube link with the YouTube Data API.

hero.eyebrow: Free demo by TKNQ · Internal R&D tool
hero.title: AI that reads a BJJ sparring tape
hero.subtitle: CodeJitsu is a free working demo from TKNQ, the all-in-one software for BJJ gyms and academies. Upload a roll and Gemini breaks it down into a timestamped match timeline, a technical grade and the drills to fix what went wrong.
hero.videoFallback: Your browser can't play this video.

status.title: A demo, not a commercial product

notForSale.title: Free, not for sale
notForSale.body: There are no plans or subscriptions here. Every account gets a small allowance of free video analyses that refills over a rolling 24 hours.

internal.title: Used internally for R&D
internal.body: The TKNQ team uses CodeJitsu to try new models, prompts and agent pipelines against real sparring footage. What we learn here shapes the software we build for gyms.

asIs.title: Provided as-is
asIs.body: Features change or break without notice, and AI feedback can be wrong. Treat the analysis as a starting point for a coach, not a verdict.

features.title: What the demo does
features.description: Everything below runs live in this demo.

analysis.title: Sparring video analysis
analysis.body: A four-phase agentic pipeline on Gemini 4 Argon profiles the athlete, logs every technique with timestamps, double-checks each call and writes a coaching report.

planning.title: Class planning
planning.body: Turns the weaknesses found in your students' footage into a structured class, then pairs partners for the live rounds.
planning.b3: Partner matching by belt, weight and experience

search.title: Technique video search
search.body: Finds instructional videos for a technique with Google Search grounding, then checks every YouTube link with the YouTube Data API before showing it.

tknq.title: Run your gym on TKNQ
tknq.description: TKNQ (pronounced “Technique”) is all-in-one business software for BJJ gyms and academies in Australia, on the web and on mobile. It takes the admin off your plate so you can spend your time on the mats, keep your members training longer and grow the BJJ community.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Memberships and payments handled in one place, with less chasing.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: See who is training every week, and who has quietly stopped turning up.

classes.title: Class management
classes.body: Keep your timetable, classes and coaches organised.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboards
leaderboard.body: Track progress and turn showing up into friendly competition.

apps.title: Web and mobile apps
apps.body: Run your academy from the front desk or from the side of the mat.

retention.title: Built for retention
retention.body: Everything in TKNQ is there to help members stay, progress and bring their friends.

tknq.note: Made for BJJ gyms and academies across Australia.

rnd.title: An R&D testbed we actually use
rnd.description: Sparring footage is long, fast and full of look-alike positions, which makes it a hard test for video-understanding models. That is exactly why TKNQ keeps CodeJitsu running internally.
rnd.p1: Benchmark new multimodal models on real footage, switching models from an admin console without a redeploy.
rnd.p2: Prototype agentic, multi-step pipelines: profile, log, verify, coach.
rnd.p3: Experiment with grounded search that verifies its own links.
rnd.p4: Keep a human in the loop: instructors can review and edit every AI output.

cta.title: See it for yourself
cta.body: Sign in to upload a tape or set up a demo class. Please don't upload footage you need to keep private.
cta.tknqPrompt: Own or run a BJJ academy?
cta.tknqButton: See what TKNQ can do for your gym

footer.line: CodeJitsu is a demo and internal R&D project by TKNQ (pronounced “Technique”). It is not a commercial product.
